# Inês Santos Silva

> Portuguese entrepreneur working on women's health. Co-Founder & COO of TejoMed, Portugal's first membership-based family medicine clinic, and Core Team at AthenaDAO, a funding platform backing early-stage biotech in women's health and ovarian aging. Co-founder of Portuguese Women in Tech. Writes and speaks on women's health, the business of health, longevity and women in tech.

Based in Portugal. Contact: hello@inessilva.me

Other roles: member of the board of advisors of FemTech Portugal; non-executive board member at Almedina, a Portuguese publisher. Alumna of the Singularity University Graduate Studies Program (2013) and THNK School of Creative Leadership (2014); Marshall Memorial Fellow (2019) of the German Marshall Fund.

## Pages

- [About](https://inessilva.me/): Bio, current roles (TejoMed, AthenaDAO, Portuguese Women in Tech, FemTech Portugal, Almedina) and links to profiles elsewhere.
- [Women's Health](https://inessilva.me/womens-health.html): Reports and articles on women's health she recommends, including AthenaDAO's Reproductive Health Reports (ovarian aging; PCOS and endometriosis; gynecological cancers) and McKinsey and World Economic Forum research on the women's health gap.
- [Articles & Podcasts](https://inessilva.me/articles.html): Her articles (Medium, Substack, Observador, Público, SAPO Tek) and podcast appearances, in English and Portuguese.
- [Speaking](https://inessilva.me/speaking): Conferences where she has spoken or moderated, including SIM Conference 2026, Women & Wealth 2026, QSP Summit 2025 and Women & Leadership 2025.
- [Salons](https://inessilva.me/salons): Small, curated salon dinners she hosts in Porto and Lisbon for 6-8 people across health, technology, business, politics, economics and philosophy. Invitation only.
- [Dispatches](https://inessilva.me/dispatches): Short notes, one or two paragraphs each, on ideas she is thinking about, newest first.
- [AI and the Future of Work](https://inessilva.me/ai-and-the-future-of-work): Her argument that AI could leave a lasting shortage of paid work (task encroachment, complementarity as a phase, productivity without jobs), with the reading behind it.
- [Bookshelf](https://inessilva.me/bookshelf.html): What she is currently reading and the books she rated five stars, grouped by topic.
